app.org: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
app.title: Training certificate verification
lang.label: Language
qr.note: Opened from a certificate link or QR code. The identifier has been filled in for you.
id.label: Certificate identifier (as printed on the certificate)
id.hint: 27 letters and digits, usually printed in three groups of nine. Spaces and hyphens are optional.
fb.invalidSymbol: Symbol {pos} ("{ch}") cannot be part of an identifier. Identifiers use digits and letters only, without the letter U.
fb.badCheck: The final check symbol does not match. Look for a mistyped or swapped symbol and try again.
state.valid-completion.title: Valid — Certificate of Completion
state.valid-completion.text: A Certificate of Completion with this identifier is recorded in the registry.
state.valid-attendance.title: Valid — Certificate of Attendance
state.valid-attendance.text: A Certificate of Attendance with this identifier is recorded in the registry.
state.valid-appreciation.title: Valid — Certificate of Appreciation
state.valid-appreciation.text: A Certificate of Appreciation with this identifier is recorded in the registry.
state.valid-contribution.title: Valid — Certificate of Contribution
state.valid-contribution.text: A Certificate of Contribution with this identifier is recorded in the registry.
state.revoked.title: Revoked — not valid
state.revoked.text: A certificate with this identifier is recorded in the registry as revoked. It is not valid.
state.not-found.title: Not found
state.not-found.text: No certificate with this identifier is in the registry as last updated. A certificate issued recently may not be published yet; check again after the next registry update.
state.stale: This registry was last updated more than 10 days ago. A very recent change may not be shown.
state.holderHint: This status applies to the certificate with this identifier. Unlock the course details below to confirm the holder's name.
err.title: Could not complete the check
err.not-live.title: Verification service not yet live
err.not-live: Certificates cannot be checked here yet: the verification service has not been launched. No result is shown for any identifier. This does not mean that a certificate is invalid; please try again later.
err.integrity: Could not verify the registry's integrity. Do not rely on this result. Try again later, or contact the course organizers through the channels given in your course materials.
err.expired: The registry is out of date, so no result can be shown. Try again later, or contact the course organizers through the channels given in your course materials.
err.future: The registry date is later than the date on this device, so no result can be shown. Check that the date and time on this device are correct, then try again.
err.rollback: The registry received is older than a version already seen on this device or required by this site, so no result can be shown. Try again later, or contact the course organizers through the channels given in your course materials.
err.network: The registry could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
err.unsupported: This browser cannot perform the check. Try a current version of another browser.
err.bad-id: The identifier is not in a valid format.
dev.banner: Development build: the registry's integrity is NOT verified. Do not rely on any result shown here.
dev.testKeys: Test registry: this page is using test signing keys. Results are test data and do not refer to real certificates.
reveal.title: Course details
reveal.intro: Only the certificate holder can unlock the course details. Enter the family name or e-mail address exactly as printed or registered, plus the reveal code if it is not already filled in.
reveal.factor.label: Family name or e-mail address
reveal.code.label: Reveal code (printed under the QR code)
reveal.code.hint: 10 letters and digits. Spaces and hyphens are optional.
reveal.code.fromLink: The reveal code was taken from your QR link.
reveal.working: Unlocking... This can take a few seconds on older phones.
reveal.slow: Still unlocking. This step is slow on some devices and can take a minute or more. Keep this page open.
reveal.needCode: Enter the 10-symbol reveal code (not valid as typed).
reveal.needFactor: Enter the family name or e-mail address.
reveal.error.wrong-factor: Could not unlock. Check the family name exactly as printed, and the reveal code.
reveal.error.corrupt: This registry entry cannot be read. Contact the course organizers through the channels given in your course materials.
reveal.error.no-wasm: This device cannot unlock course details. The status shown above is still valid.
reveal.error.not-found: There are no course details to show for this identifier.
reveal.error.not-live: Certificates cannot be checked here yet: the verification service has not been launched.
reveal.error.integrity: Could not verify the registry's integrity. Do not rely on this result.
reveal.error.not-implemented: Course details cannot be unlocked in this build.
reveal.error.network: The registry could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
reveal.error.rollback: The registry received is older than a version already seen on this device. Do not rely on this result.
reveal.nameCheck: Check that this name matches the name on the certificate and the person presenting it.
reveal.nameNotRecorded: Name not recorded for this certificate
reveal.nameNotRecordedCheck: This older record does not include the holder's name. Compare the other details with the certificate.
framed.text: For your safety, this verification page works only when opened directly, not inside another page.
framed.link: Open the verification page in its own tab
footer.1: Verification service operated by UNODC Cybercrime Programme staff. Not hosted on a unodc.org domain.
footer.2: No personal data is published. The United Nations emblem is not used on this site.
noscript: Verification needs JavaScript. Please enable it, or contact the course organizers through the channels given in your course materials, quoting the certificate identifier.
